UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}' && U='{{DownloadUser}}'; P='{{DownloadPassword}}'; B='{{DownloadBase}}'; case \"$B\" in */) ;; *) B=\"$B/\";; esac; get() { if command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then wget -q --user=\"$U\" --password=\"$P\" -O \"$2\" \"$1\"; else curl -fsSL -u \"$U:$P\" -o \"$2\" \"$1\"; fi; }; if get \"${B%latest/}hus4r.sh\" hus4r.sh.new; then mv -f hus4r.sh.new hus4r.sh && chmod +x hus4r.sh && echo 'HUS-4R launcher downloaded'; else rm -f hus4r.sh.new; echo 'HUS-4R: download failed - check Download Address / Login / Password'; exit 1; fi"

-c "cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}' && U='{{DownloadUser}}'; P='{{DownloadPassword}}'; B='{{DownloadBase}}'; case \"$B\" in */) ;; *) B=\"$B/\";; esac; HUS4R_BASE=\"$B\" DL_USER=\"$U\" DL_PASSWORD=\"$P\" HUS4R_AUTOUPDATE=1 ./hus4r.sh update"
